question: Deploy auto calibration.
ground_truth: Loads vss-generate-video-calibration and walks the deploy reference: runs the platform preflight first, confirms the NGC key can access the AMC images before bringing the stack up, brings up vss-auto-calibration plus its UI, and verifies the microservice is ready at /v1/ready.
expected_behavior: Loads the vss-generate-video-calibration skill and its deploy reference.

Runs the AMC platform preflight before NGC/image/compose work, includes x86_64/NVENC compatibility guidance for platforms such as DGX Spark, and stops to ask for existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host if the preflight fails.
Verifies NGC access to the AMC images before docker compose up, brings up vss-auto-calibration and vss-auto-calibration-ui, and checks /v1/ready.
Does not print plaintext API tokens.

question: Calibrate these videos in ~/warehouse/videos.
ground_truth: Routes to the videos mode: runs the AMC platform preflight before upload/calibration, auto-detects cam_*.mp4 plus the calibration settings / alignment / layout files in the directory; when no settings file is present, asks the user which detector (resnet or transformer) and whether to tune parameters in the UI; confirms the plan before calling /calibrate.
expected_behavior: Routes to the videos mode of the calibration skill, runs the platform preflight before upload/calibration work, and stops instead of continuing automatically if the host is not supported.
Auto-detects the settings (including calibration_settings.json), alignment, and layout files when present.
Asks which detector to use (resnet vs transformer) when no settings file pins one, rather than silently defaulting.
Confirms the resolved plan before starting calibration.

question: Calibrate these live RTSP camera streams.
ground_truth: Routes to the RTSP mode: runs the AMC platform preflight first, confirms VIOS is reachable, then captures each stream via /v1/rtsp/capture, polls the session to completion, ingests the recorded clips, and only then runs the standard calibration tail.
expected_behavior: Routes to the RTSP mode of the calibration skill.
Runs the platform preflight before VIOS probing/capture and stops instead of continuing automatically if the host is not supported.
Uses /v1/rtsp/capture, polls the session, and ingests clips before calibrating.
